description: Return the Market Multiple Positioning band (Premium/Average/Discount) for a state or ZIP-prefix metro versus the PUBLIC national dental practice-sale benchmark (Levin/FOCUS/BizBuySell), with the four driving factors (DSO competition, demographics, scarcity, retirement supply), a 0-100 confidence score, and a disclaimer that it is market context, NOT a transaction comp or practice-specific valuation. Cheaper single-metric alternative to the positioning block embedded in get_territory_summary. Scope is a 2-letter enriched-state code, optionally narrowed to a 3-digit ZIP prefix (metro grain). County/city scoping is intentionally not offered.

state.description: Two-letter enriched-state code (e.g. TX, NM, FL). Required.

zip.description: Optional ZIP prefix for metro-grain scope (3+ digits; truncated to the leading 3, e.g. '770' for Houston). Omit for whole-state.

name: get_market_positioning
